How Tools Should Work

Functional fields
MotifsHelp readers find mirrors, names, roads, water, omens, and other recurring story patterns SourcesHelp readers separate known folklore, unclear claims, retellings, and source-limited material PathsSuggest next reads across archive stories, board guides, and creator library material NavigationMake a large text archive easier to scan without turning search into the main experience

Why separate tools?

Tools should be useful fields beside the city, not more road signs.

Archive and Library are content buildings. Tools should help readers do something specific: compare, filter, check, or build a path.
